hero.body: Ecommerce Website Development Company in Kochi — Teknoppy builds custom, mobile-first, conversion-focused online stores that help Kerala businesses sell more, both at home in India and to customers around the world. Since 2018, we have delivered 120+ website and ecommerce projects, from compact single-brand stores to large multi-vendor marketplaces, helping Kerala brands sell online with confidence.

introBand: Every business today needs more than a shopping cart. It needs a fast, secure, search-optimised platform that turns visitors into paying customers and handles payments, stock, and shipping without friction. As a dedicated ecommerce development company in Kochi, Teknoppy combines clean store design with secure payment integration, Product schema markup, and Core Web Vitals optimisation — so your store does not just look great, it ranks and sells. Our clients include startups, retailers, Ayurveda and export brands, manufacturers, and established enterprises across Kochi, Thrissur, Calicut, Trivandrum, and the wider Kerala market.

platforms.intro: There is no single best ecommerce platform — only the right one for your catalogue, your team and the way you plan to sell. Teknoppy builds and supports stores on the four foundations below, and recommends one only after reviewing your products, budget and growth plans.

items.name: WooCommerce
items.desc: Your store runs on WordPress, so you own the code, the content and the customer data outright — with deep control over SEO and no per-sale platform fee.
items.bestFor: Content-led brands that want ownership and search depth

items.name: Shopify
items.desc: Hosting, security patches and platform updates are handled for you, so the store stays online and current without a separate maintenance retainer for the platform itself.
items.bestFor: Brands that want to launch quickly with predictable running costs

items.name: Custom & Headless
items.desc: A storefront written around your own workflows, or decoupled from the backend so a single product catalogue can serve a website, an app and other sales channels at once.
items.bestFor: Large catalogues, B2B pricing rules and multi-channel selling

items.name: Multi-Vendor Marketplace
items.desc: Seller onboarding, vendor dashboards, commission handling and automated order routing, built so multiple sellers can list and fulfil side by side under your brand.
items.bestFor: Platforms where you host sellers rather than sell yourself

platforms.footnote: Already selling on a platform that is holding you back? We move stores between all four — products, customer accounts, order history and existing Google rankings intact.

process.intro: Our ecommerce development process follows six clearly defined stages, ensuring every project is delivered on time, within budget, and built precisely to brief:

steps.title: Discovery & Goal Mapping
steps.desc: A structured brief covering products, target markets, competitors, and technical needs. We map your local SEO area from the start.

steps.title: Sitemap & URL Architecture
steps.desc: Category and product URL planning and internal linking, defined before design to prevent cannibalization and ensure crawlability.

steps.title: Wireframing & UX Design
steps.desc: Low-fidelity wireframes first, then high-fidelity mockups. You approve the layout before a line of code is written.

steps.title: Development & Schema
steps.desc: Clean, mobile-first code with Product, Offer, Organisation, BreadcrumbList, and FAQPage schema built in for rich results.

steps.title: Payments, SEO & Speed
steps.desc: Secure gateway setup, optimised metadata, image compression, Core Web Vitals tuning, and Search Console verification. Need ongoing growth? See our ecommerce SEO services.

steps.title: Launch, Testing & Handover
steps.desc: Full cross-device and checkout testing, sitemap submission, and a clear handover document covering store management.

faqs.intro: Get quick answers to standard questions about ecommerce website development pricing, platforms, process, and technical SEO features:

items.q: How much does ecommerce website development cost in Kochi?
items.a: A standard online store typically costs between Rs. 45,000 and Rs. 2,00,000 depending on product count, features, and design. Custom and marketplace platforms cost more. A detailed written quote is provided before any project begins.

items.q: Will I own my online store?
items.a: Yes. The domain, store account, product data and design files are in your name. For WooCommerce you own the code and hosting; for Shopify you own the store account and pay Shopify's plan directly.

items.q: What are the payment gateway charges?
items.a: Gateways charge a fee per transaction (typically 1.8% to 2% for Indian cards/UPI, higher for international cards), set by the provider. We help you pick a gateway and set it up; the fee is paid directly to the gateway, not to Teknoppy.

items.q: Can you set up shipping and Cash on Delivery?
items.a: Yes. We integrate leading couriers and shipping aggregators (Shiprocket, Delhivery, Blue Dart) with automated tracking, custom shipping zones, delivery charges, and COD rules configured during the build.

items.q: Can you move my store to a new platform without losing Google rankings?
items.a: Yes. We map old URLs to new ones with 301 redirects and keep product data, customer records, and SEO settings intact. See our ecommerce redesign and migration service.

items.q: Which is the best platform for an ecommerce website in Kerala?
items.a: It depends on your goals. WooCommerce is best for control and SEO; Shopify for a hosted, low-maintenance store; custom builds for large or complex businesses. We recommend the right fit after understanding your products and budget.

items.q: How long does it take to build an online store in Kochi?
items.a: A standard ecommerce website takes 4 to 8 weeks from discovery to launch. Larger custom or multi-vendor platforms take 8 to 14 weeks. A written timeline is shared at the start.

items.q: Can I manage and update my store myself after launch?
items.a: Yes. We build on user-friendly platforms like WooCommerce and Shopify, giving you a simple dashboard to add products, update prices, and run offers without any coding. A handover guide and optional training are included.

items.q: Do you build ecommerce websites for international customers?
items.a: Yes. We build multi-currency, multilingual stores with international payment gateways and shipping logic — ideal for Ayurveda, handicraft, and export brands selling beyond India.

items.q: What schema markup do you implement on ecommerce stores?
items.a: Product, Offer, Organisation, BreadcrumbList, and FAQPage schema, with review and aggregate rating schema on client product pages using genuine customer reviews only.

items.q: Are your ecommerce websites SEO-friendly and mobile-first?
items.a: Yes. Every store is built mobile-first with clean code, Product schema, optimised metadata, and Core Web Vitals tuning, so it is ready to rank from launch.

items.q: Do you provide maintenance after the store goes live?
items.a: Yes. Monthly maintenance plans from Rs. 5,000 per month cover updates, security monitoring, speed checks, product edits, and technical fixes.
